description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, testing endpoints with optional and required query parameters and request bodies, using FastAPI's test client.

methods.name: read_query(q: Union[str, None])
methods.description: Endpoint function handling GET requests to '/query', returning a query parameter 'q' which may be a string or None.

methods.name: read_explicit_query(q: Union[str, None] = Query())
methods.description: Endpoint function handling GET requests to '/explicit-query', returning a query parameter 'q' with explicit Query() validation.

methods.name: send_body_embed(b: Union[str, None] = Body(embed=True))
methods.description: Endpoint function handling POST requests to '/body-embed', accepting a JSON body 'b' that may be a string or None, with embedded schema.

methods.name: test_required_nonable_query_invalid()
methods.description: Test function verifying that missing required query parameter 'q' on '/query' returns a 422 status code.

methods.name: test_required_noneable_query_value()
methods.description: Test function verifying that providing 'q' parameter to '/query' returns status 200 and the correct JSON response.

methods.name: test_required_nonable_explicit_query_invalid()
methods.description: Test function verifying that missing required explicit query parameter 'q' on '/explicit-query' returns 422.

methods.name: test_required_nonable_explicit_query_value()
methods.description: Test function verifying that providing 'q' to '/explicit-query' returns 200 and the expected value.

methods.name: test_required_nonable_body_embed_no_content()
methods.description: Test function verifying POST to '/body-embed' with no JSON body results in 422.

methods.name: test_required_nonable_body_embed_invalid()
methods.description: Test function verifying POST to '/body-embed' with invalid JSON structure results in 422.

methods.name: test_required_noneable_body_embed_value()
methods.description: Test function verifying POST to '/body-embed' with valid JSON body returns 200 and correct JSON response.
